commentary_summary: The utilisation of Suezmax continued to decline last week due to the ample tonnage list in the Atlantic region, which weighed on the Suezmax rates. Unless demand surges in the pre-Christmas week, the rates are expected to soften for the next two weeks. | Meanwhile, the tonne-mile index remained flat due to a lack of activity. Despite the subdued demand this month, owners are expecting a busier period in January as the country needs to replenish its reserves after the peak demand season.
